customPages.title: Schools
customPages.content:
Welcome to the African Cultural Field Trip program at Afro Baobab Cultural Hub. Our curriculum-aligned, interactive modules are designed to spark wonder, curiosity, and cultural understanding in students of all age groups.

🎒 WHAT STUDENTS WILL EXPERIENCE:
• Under the Story Canopy: Hands-on oral history narratives under our giant woven baobab tree, incorporating immersive audio, lighting and live dramatic interaction.
• Rhythm and Drums: Practical djembe drum circles teaching alignment, coordination, and community pulse led by master rhythmic musicians.
• Creative Clay & Beading: Craft workshops where pupils mould artifacts or construct tribal patterns using traditional beads, teaching geometric layout and history.
• Interactive Exhibition Tour: Guided walks around our active historical visual galleries, tailored to schools' specific regional curriculums.

🏫 CURRICULUM SYNDICATION:
We cater to IB, British, American, CBSE, and MOE frameworks.

📋 BOOKING LOGISTICS:
• Timings: Morning sessions available from 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM.
• Group Size: Accommodating up to 60 students per flight.

✉️ FIELD TRIP INQUIRIES:
Please use our Guest Inquiries section below or click Booking in the navigation bar to submit a reservation enquiry.

customPages.title: Corporate
customPages.content:
Cultivate teamwork, ignite artistic inspiration, and expand cross-cultural intelligence with Afro Baobab's bespoke Corporate Experience Programs in Dubai.

👔 EXECUTIVE & DIVISIONAL TEAM EXPERIENCES:
• Creative Rhythm Circles: Highly active djembe drum alignment workshops. Experience group resonance, cooperative communication, and synergistic pulse.
• Shared Visual Tapestry: Collaborative painting and bead weaving modules where team participants work on a single massive canvas.
• Cross-Cultural Leadership & CQ: Seminars focusing on narrative leadership and adapting them to complex modern organizational strategy.
• Gourmet Afro-Fusion Dinners: Fine-art culinary journeys featuring traditional communal sharing plates, live music accompaniment, and coffee roast presentations.

🛎️ TEAM EVENT LOGISTICS:
• Exclusive Venue Buyout: Private access to our art gallery, meeting salon, and storytelling room.

✉️ COLLABORATION REQUESTS:
Please declare your team objectives by tapping Booking in our navigation menu.
